metadata.title: West Bengal Soils - Part 5: Ganga-Brahmaputra Active Delta
metadata.region_covered: North 24 Parganas (northern and central), South 24 Parganas (northern), Nadia (eastern)
metadata.source: National Bureau of Soil Survey and Land Use Planning (ICAR), Nagpur
metadata.special_features: Dynamic delta soils with high agricultural potential, requires acidity management

properties.soil_name: Grey to brown loamy soils, Fresh water delta soils
properties.usda_classification: Fine to Very Fine Loamy, Typic Endoaquepts
properties.texture_detailed: Silt loam, Silty clay loam, Very fine sandy loam
properties.land_use: Paddy (double to triple crop), Jute, Vegetables, Betel leaf
properties.land_capability: Class II-III (Good for rice and vegetables)
properties.irrigation_suitability: Moderate - needs drainage in wet season
properties.limitations: Poor drainage, Strong acidity, Seasonal waterlogging, Aluminium toxicity risk, Flooding risk
properties.management_practices: Lime application (essential), Drainage improvement, Organic matter addition, Zinc and sulphur application, Green manuring
properties.productivity_rating: High for rice, Medium to high for vegetables
properties.description: Very deep, poorly drained, fine to very fine loamy soils on nearly level active delta plains; strongly to moderately acid reaction. These productive delta soils support intensive rice-based cropping systems but require lime application for optimal productivity.

properties.usda_classification: Fine to Very Fine Loamy, Typic Endoaquepts
properties.texture_detailed: Silt loam, Very fine sandy loam, Silty clay loam
properties.land_capability: Class II-III (Good for rice, limited for upland crops)
properties.limitations: Poor to very poor drainage, Moderate to strong acidity, Prolonged waterlogging (5-7 months), Limited dry season cropping
properties.management_practices: Drainage critical, Lime application, Early maturing rice varieties, Limited rabi cropping, Zinc application
properties.productivity_rating: High for wetland rice, Low for dry season crops
properties.description: Very deep, poorly to very poorly drained, fine to very fine loamy soils on nearly level active delta plains; moderately acid to slightly acid reaction. These soils are best suited for wetland rice and have severe limitations for dry season agriculture.

properties.soil_name: Grey to dark grey loamy soils
properties.usda_classification: Fine to Very Fine Loamy, Typic Haplaquepts
properties.texture_detailed: Silt loam, Very fine sandy loam
properties.parent_material: Recent deltaic alluvium in basin positions
properties.slope_class: Nearly level active delta plains (basin positions)
properties.land_capability: Class II (Good agricultural land with acid management)
properties.limitations: Moderate drainage impairment, Strong acidity, Seasonal waterlogging (3-5 months), Aluminium toxicity potential
properties.management_practices: Lime application (important), Improved drainage, Balanced fertilization, Organic matter incorporation, Zinc and boron application
properties.productivity_rating: High (with proper lime and drainage management)
properties.description: Very deep, somewhat poorly to poorly drained, fine to very fine loamy soils on nearly level active delta plains; strongly to moderately acid reaction. These soils have good agricultural potential with proper acidity management and drainage improvement.

properties.soil_name: Brown to grey brown loamy soils, Natural levee soils
properties.usda_classification: Fine to Very Fine Loamy, Typic Haplaquepts
properties.texture_detailed: Loam, Silt loam, Very fine sandy loam
properties.drainage: Moderately well drained to well drained
properties.parent_material: Recent deltaic deposits on natural levees
properties.slope_class: Gently sloping levee-like features of active delta
properties.land_use: Paddy, Vegetables, Jute, Banana, Betel leaf, Homestead gardens
properties.limitations: Minor - slight acidity in some areas, seasonal moisture stress possible
properties.management_practices: Balanced fertilization, Crop rotation, Organic manuring, Minor lime application if needed, Efficient irrigation
properties.description: Very deep, moderately well to well drained, fine to very fine loamy soils on gently sloping levee-like features of active delta; slightly acid to neutral reaction. These are the most productive soils in the delta region, ideal for intensive agriculture and homestead gardens.

properties.soil_name: Brown loamy soils, Delta ridge soils
properties.usda_classification: Fine Loamy to Fine, Typic Ustifluvents
properties.parent_material: Recent alluvial deposits on elevated features
properties.land_use: Paddy, Jute, Vegetables, Fruit orchards, Settlements
properties.limitations: Minimal - very minor limitations for agriculture
properties.management_practices: Balanced fertilization, Efficient irrigation, Crop diversification, Orchard development, Organic farming potential
properties.productivity_rating: Very high - among the best soils in West Bengal
properties.special_features: Ideal for high-value horticulture, organic farming, and diversified agriculture
properties.description: Very deep, moderately well to well drained, fine loamy to fine soils on gently sloping levee-like elevated features; slightly acid to slightly alkaline reaction. These premium soils represent the best agricultural land in the active delta, suitable for all major crops and high-value horticulture.

management_priorities.critical: Lime application for WB26-28, Drainage improvement for WB26-27
management_priorities.important: Zinc and micronutrient management, Organic matter maintenance
management_priorities.beneficial: Crop diversification on WB29-30, Horticulture development

summary.agricultural_potential: Very high - these delta soils support intensive rice-vegetable cropping systems and have potential for crop diversification
